LanguageData.Gun_PMM_RWP.description: The PMM is a compact semi-automatic pistol known for its reliability and ease of use. Chambered in 9x18mm, it offers decent stopping power for its size, making it a solid sidearm choice for self-defense or short-range combat situations. Its lightweight design ensures quick handling and minimal encumbrance. Perfect for colonists needing a balance between firepower and mobility.
